newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN Amro initiates Siderar as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN Amro initiates Siderar as buy.

text.p: - ABN Amro Hoare Govett said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Argentina's steelmaker Siderar as a buy.
- ABN said Siderar's strategy of focussing on "higher added-value products will bring significant improvements in earnings as the Argentine economy recovers."
- ABN Amro has a target price for Siderar of 3.65 pesos, representing a 23.3 percent rise on the current price of 3.09 pesos.
- Share dividend is projected to rise to 0.07 pesos this year, 0.10 pesos in 1998 and 0.11 pesos in 1999 from 0.04 pesos last year.
- Earnings are seen rising to 85.4 million pesos this fiscal year, 113.8 million pesos in 1998 and 130.8 million pesos in 1999 compared with 61 million pesos last year.
- Capacity expansion and planned investments elsewhere in Latin America will boost the company, said ABN.
